title.zh: 统计推断、实验设计与回归

lead.en: Construct confidence coverage and null tails, preserve independent units in comparisons and resampling, derive regression likelihoods, and protect final evaluation from selection.
lead.zh: 构造置信覆盖与原假设尾，比较重抽时保留独立单位，推导回归似然，保护最终评估免受选择影响。

prerequisites.en: Modules 12, 19 and 25; Module 24's sampling guarantees are used throughout. Labs 1 and 3 use the standard library; Lab 2 uses the pinned NumPy environment.
prerequisites.zh: 需模块 12、19、25，全程用模块 24 抽样保证。实验 1、3 标准库，实验 2 需固定 NumPy 环境。

en: Construct and interpret confidence coverage with exact or approximate assumptions stated.
Define valid null tails, effect sizes and prospective power.
Distinguish assignment, sampling, pairing and confounding.
Implement bootstrap and permutation with their different contracts.
Derive linear/logistic likelihoods and distinguish mean from outcome prediction.
Design splits, preprocessing and multiplicity plans that support the claimed evaluation.
zh: 构造并解释覆盖，明确精确或近似条件。
定义有效原假设尾、效应量与前瞻功效。
区分分配、抽样、配对及混杂。
按不同条件实施自助与置换。
推线性/logistic 似然，区分均值及结果预测。
设计拆分、预处理和多重计划以支持评估声明。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and derive confidence events and null-tail validity.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，推置信事件与尾有效性。

text.en: Read the sampling interpretation of inference.
Retrieve coverage, significance and effect-scale distinctions.
text.zh: 检索覆盖、显著与效应尺度区别。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and specify each assignment/resampling unit.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，指定分配和重抽单位。

text.en: Compare bootstrap variation with exact permutation tails.
text.zh: 比较自助波动和精确置换尾。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and derive regression targets and split rules.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，推回归目标与拆分规则。

text.en: Fit regression and inspect held-out residual and calibration diagnostics.
text.zh: 拟合回归并查看保留数据残差与校准。

text.en: Diagnose rare-event coverage, selection optimism and copied units.
text.zh: 诊断罕见覆盖、选择乐观性与副本单位。

text.en: Complete choices and write a comparison protocol.
text.zh: 完成选择并写比较协议。
阅读重抽和模型选择条件。

text.en: Complete the exit task and audit statistical conclusions.
text.zh: 完成结业并核查统计结论。
